description: Older tool to open a ticket with human support; new integrations should use everyinfra_create_ticket, which works with any key. Replies come from staff, not from an AI. Without idempotency_key, the same title and message are opened once per UTC day, so a retry does not open a second ticket. Returns object ticket.created with the ticket as support recorded it. Example: {"title": "Empty results for one profile", "message": "request_id req_abc123 returned no items."}. Needs the support:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, 8-128 letters, digits or _.:@-; keep it when retrying

message.description: Plain text, 1-4000 characters; include request_id values when relevant

name: everyinfra_ticket_create
title: Open a support ticket
